answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 65364 Country: India Title: My daughter marriage gatting very late Question: I am a divorced woman and I try to search a good man for my daughter age goes to 28. I am very depressed what I can do? Answer ID: 65364 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 769/767/N=08/1437) Ask your daughter to offer two rakah Salatul Hajah in privacy daily after Isha salah and read the following dua 101 times with durood 7-7 times before and after: يا بديع العجائب بالخير يا بديع . After that she should supplicate Allah wholeheartedly for a suitable proposal. (Fatawa Mahmoodia 20: 89, 90, Question: 9623, Pub. Idarah Siddiq Dhabel). In-shaAllah, soon a suitable proposal shall come. Yes, during the menstruation period she should only read the dua and supplicate and must not offer Salatul Hajah as it is not lawful for a woman to offer salah during her menstruation period. You should also pray for her best and suitable match. In-shaAllah, your dua shall be accepted soon. May Allah arrange a suitable and better proposal for your daughter quickly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
